input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. The icons contain no lettering at all. Tile 1: a quote document turning into an order slip with a small arrow; label exactly 'Quote to Order'. Tile 2: an invoice with a coin and a check mark; label exactly 'Order to Cash'. Tile 3: two contact cards with a two-way arrow; label exactly 'Customer Sync'. Tile 4: a price tag with a product catalogue booklet; label exactly 'Price Lists'. Tile 5: a web form with a magnet pulling in a lead card; label exactly 'Lead Capture'. Tile 6: a calendar with a bell; label exactly 'Renewal Reminders'. A single small yellow spark sits near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no connecting lines, no arrows between tiles, no dotted paths anywhere. The only text in the image is the six tile labels, all bold and perfectly spelled.
